gentle.label: gentle reminder
gentle.subject: Invoice {number} — friendly reminder
body: Hi {greeting_name}, hope things are going well. A friendly reminder that invoice {number} ({amount}, due {due}) is now {overdue} past due. It may already be on its way — if so, thank you, and please ignore this.
Payment details are below in case they're handy. {payment}

firm.label: firmer follow-up
firm.subject: Invoice {number} — quick follow-up
body: Hi {greeting_name}, just a quick note that invoice {number} ({amount}, due {due}) is now {overdue} past due. Could you confirm it's in the queue?
Happy to resend the invoice or sort out a different payment method if that's easier. {payment}

escalation.label: escalation
escalation.subject: Invoice {number} — now {overdue} overdue
body: Hi {greeting_name}, I'm following up again on invoice {number} ({amount}, due {due}), which is now {overdue} past due. I haven't been able to confirm a payment date yet, so I wanted to check whether anything is holding it up — a missing PO, a change in who handles payables, or a question about the work itself.
If it helps, I can send a copy straight to whoever processes payments, or we can jump on a quick call. Could you let me know an expected payment date this week? {payment}

final.label: final notice
final.subject: Final reminder: invoice {number} ({amount})
body: Hi {greeting_name}, this is my final scheduled reminder about invoice {number} ({amount}, due {due}), now {overdue} past due. I'd really like to get this resolved with you directly.
Could you reply with a payment date, or let me know if there's a problem with the invoice we should sort out first? If paying in instalments would make it easier, I'm open to that. {payment}
